ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle centered at R, with P, Q, M, N on the circle; R is connected respectively to P, Q, M, N. P, R, M are on the same straight line, therefore PM is a diameter. The central angle ∠PRQ is marked as 115° in the figure. Reasoning: Because PM is a diameter, rays RP and RM are opposite rays, and ∠PRM = 180°. The required arc MQ is intercepted by the central angle ∠MRQ. Since ∠PRQ + ∠QRM = 180°, ∠MRQ = 180° - 115° = 65°. The measure of arc MQ equals the measure of its corresponding central angle, therefore m arc MQ = 65°.

raw_record.question_text: $\overline{PM}$ is a diameter of $\odot R$. Find $m\widehat{MQ}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: circle centered at R has radii drawn to P, Q, M, and N; P, R, and M lie on the same straight line, matching the text statement that PM is a diameter. The central angle between RP and RQ is labeled 115°. Since PM is a diameter, ray RM is opposite ray RP, so angle PRM is 180°. Therefore the central angle subtending arc MQ is angle MRQ = 180° - 115° = 65°. Hence m arc MQ = 65.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 R 为圆心的圆，P、Q、M、N 在圆上；从 R 分别连到 P、Q、M、N。P、R、M 在同一直线上，因此 PM 是直径。图中标出中心角 ∠PRQ 为 115°。推理：因为 PM 是直径，所以射线 RP 和 RM 是相反射线，∠PRM = 180°。要求的弧 MQ 由中心角 ∠MRQ 截得。由于 ∠PRQ + ∠QRM = 180°，所以 ∠MRQ = 180° - 115° = 65°。弧 MQ 的度数等于其对应中心角的度数，因此 m弧MQ = 65°。
